name: PhotoPrism
compose:
services:
  photoprism:
    image: photoprism/photoprism:240915
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports: ["2342:2342"]
    environment:
      PHOTOPRISM_ADMIN_PASSWORD: changeme
    volumes:
      - ${DATA}/storage:/photoprism/storage
      - /volume1/photo:/photoprism/originals
